definitions.recycle: Replace the active prompt history with a bounded projection while retaining exact evidence in durable storage.
definitions.safe_dispatch: A single stateless request whose measured input plus enforced output reservation is strictly below the recycle boundary.
definitions.recovery: Resume an idle, scope-bound checkpoint; refuse unknown in-flight outcomes.

requirements: Gate every opted-in iterative model dispatch before invocation
Measure complete assembled prompt and provider overhead through a source-reviewed adapter
No automatic retries; unsupported transports fail closed
Preserve exact caller-supplied objective, constraints, pending work, facts and lessons
Persist full tool history before replacing the prompt projection; provide bounded evidence retrieval
Pin scope and policy on resume; persist request reservation before invocation
Never replay ambiguous model or tool execution
Native Codex compaction remains unsupported until host integration
claim_limit: Local source-reviewed stateless adapter and deterministic fake-provider tests only; no live model or semantic completeness claim.
